meta.dataSnapshot: mateicanavra/civ7-official-resources @ 9f6b93e129d47faf96ed6814f652560e7b7573d0 (snapshot 2026-10-01, includes all DLC folders in repo)
meta.provenance: All content parsed from shipped game XML (Base/modules/* and DLC/*/modules/*) and en_us text; Delete rows applied. Mastery = UnlockDepth=2 rows of the same node. unlock condition fields (requiredTraitType=civ-only, requiredGovernmentType=government-gated policy) copied from data. Interpretive notes marked secondary.
notes: Civ VII calls slotted cards "policies" (common, from civics tree) and "traditions" (civ-unique, from unique civics trees); both are rows in the Traditions table; categorisation here: TraitType present => tradition.

Exploration common tree = TREE_CIVICS_EX_MAIN (13 incl. Future Civic) + TREE_CIVICS_EX_BRANCH_THEOLOGY (Theology, Reformation). Modern = TREE_CIVICS_MO_MAIN (10 incl. Future Civic) + 3 ideology branch trees x 3 nodes.

testOfTime = trees for the Test of Time mode content (civ-injected Foundation/Hierarchy/Administration, Syncretism, and per-civ Origins/Renaissance/Modernization bridge nodes) - shipped in base data, separate from the standard common tree.
